text:
Morgan: Heads up — dashboard alerted on some quota attribution spikes this morning, looks like lots of requests being billed to the default org instead of the originating project. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
Anita: Yup saw it at 08:12. Telemetry shows a jump in 'token_owner' = org-unknown for many SA proxied calls.
Ryan: I dug in — the proxy that synthesizes the impersonation claim sometimes drops the project_id when the request hits the authz cache miss path. Repro steps minimal.
Kevin: Do you have a quick snippet? I can try on staging.
Ryan: Here's the header mapping we use in the proxy right now:
```
X-Redwood-Svc: sa-12345
X-Redwood-Claim: {"sub":"sa-12345","project": "proj-xyz"}
```
But when we do cache-refresh flow (async token exchange) we reconstruct claims from the introspection response and we were only preserving `org` not `project` because of a rename in last week's change.
Anita: So the console is attributing to org fallback when project missing — that's intended, but the spike is abnormal scale.
Morgan: How many requests affected in prod? ProductOps do we have an approximate user impact / billing surface? @ProductOps
ProductOps: We see ~1.8K unique API keys affected over a 30m window, aggregated cost ~2% of hourly spend. Some customers pinged support about wrong project showing in logs.
infra-bot: alert: quota-attribution-spike detected (severity: medium) — runbook: check proxy exchange logs, authz-cache metrics.
Kevin: Quick fix candidate: default the missing project claim to the original key's owner project at proxy-time (best-effort), and emit a telemetry tag `claim_reconstructed=1` so we can filter.
Ryan: Agree. Short-term patch looks safe. Longer term we should change token-exchange to always return canonical claim shape and add unit tests.
Anita: We also need console UX changes — show a provenance badge on request detail: "Project inferred" vs "Project asserted" so support isn't confused.
Morgan: I'll take the rollout plan. Proposal: patch proxy on staging, smoke test for 2 hours, enable canary (5%) in prod for 30m, expand to 100% if no errors. Add alert threshold to rollback if reconstructed > 0.5% of requests for a customer.
Kevin: Add a polyfill in the authz cache layer so that even if proxy fails to attach project, cache lookup will attempt owner->project resolution.
Ryan: Putting a quick PR: small patch + telemetry tag + unit test. Will mark [WIP].
Anita: For dashboards — add two graphs: 1) rate of `claim_reconstructed` by org, 2) fraction of requests with missing `project` before/after patch. We need both for postmortem.
ProductOps: Also request a one-off export of affected traces for the top 10 orgs so we can contact them proactively.
Morgan: Communication plan: brief status in #incidents and a short note in the console "we corrected an attribution issue; you may see updated logs" if rollout hits prod. Also prepare an internal KB entry.
Ryan: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/5423 (WIP) — validates claim present on proxy, emits `claim_reconstructed` boolean in telemetry.
Kevin: Quick checklist for rollout: 1) smoke tests on staging 2) run synthetic load that simulates authz-cache miss 3) canary 5% for 30m 4) monitor `claim_reconstructed` and `quota_mismatch` alerts 5) rollback script ready.
Anita: UX tick: add small orange flag in request inspector "inferred project" and a hover tooltip explaining inference heuristics.
ProductOps: I'll queue support templates for customers who report changed logs (keep it calm, explain we fixed attribution and logs may retroactively show updated project mapping).
infra-bot: deploy: staging/proxy-service:v2.3.7 deployed at 09:40 (ok)
Ryan: Staging smoke looks good. Generating synthetic cache-miss load now.
Ryan: Synthetic run shows reconstructed rate ~0.9% under heavy churn. Adding unit test and a small backoff to avoid thrashing the authz service.
Morgan: Proceeding to canary at 5% in prod. @everyone monitor for 15m.
Anita: Dashboard panels added: `claim_reconstructed_count` and `missing_project_fraction` — visible in eng-platform/home.
Kevin: Canary 5% running. No errors so far. `claim_reconstructed` ~0.6% globally, but for the affected orgs it's 12% — that's expected.
ProductOps: Starting outreach to top 3 affected customers with a note.
Ryan: Canary looks stable at 30m. Bumped to 50% for another 30m.
infra-bot: alert suppressed: quota-attribution-spike (auto-muted during rollback window)
Morgan: 50% stable; going to 100% now. Keep watch for any customer-facing alerts.
Anita: Follow-ups: (1) spec change to token-exchange API to always include project claim (2) console UX ticket to show provenance and allow filtering by `claim_reconstructed` (3) add retroactive correction job to backfill logs where possible.
Kevin: I'll own the token-exchange spec PR. Plan: add `project` as required field in introspection response and bump minor version.
Ryan: Merging PR to main now. Will attach release notes and the unit tests.
Morgan: Thanks all. Filing a short postmortem template once we have one-week telemetry to confirm no recurrence. :thumbsup:
Anita: Adding postmortem checklist to /docs/internal/postmortems/sa-attribution-3369998888.md (draft).
ProductOps: Closing the loop with support drafts sent. Will track customer replies.
infra-bot: archive: thread id 3369998888 closed by Morgan at 11:05.
